### Added

- (agent-platform) [Add the Platform section's cluster page with its Overview tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3578) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Where the Platform section is turned on (`gs.features.platformSection.enabled`), a cluster in its clusters list opens a page of its own with `Copy login command`, `View manifest` and an Overview of its release, labels and annotations, GitOps delivery and technical details. On every installation, the Clusters pages and the GPU pool sizes say `CPU` instead of `vCPUs`.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Organizations asks only the environments that are on, and lists unchecked installations behind one line](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3612) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — The Organizations page asks only the environments you turned on, links each organization's name, and lists the installations it could not check behind one collapsed line, such as `Organizations could not be checked on 3 installations`, instead of a warning for each.
- (muster) [Tell two organizations' connectors of one name apart on the Connectors page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3608) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The Connectors page no longer fails to load when two organizations each have a connector of the same name: each gets its own row with its status, tools and sign-in, and a connector's page signs in, reconnects and turns off that very connector.
- (ui-react, agent-platform) [Set no text below 12px in the facts column](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3606) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On an agent's Overview tab, the details on the right (the model's provider, the runtime's harness, the email under `Created by`) are 12px instead of 10px.

### Development and CI/CD

- (layout-check) [Report tables that scroll sideways or squeeze a column, and check 1024 and 1160](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3607) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The layout check also reports tables that scroll sideways or squeeze a column, and checks 1024 and 1160 pixel widths by default.
- (plans) [Serve the fixture scenarios in Hive and the plan list](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3604) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Fixture mode serves its scenarios in Hive. On the side: long titles in the side cards of Hive's Now tab wrap, long plan names no longer make the Plans tab scroll sideways, and a plan's review stacks on phones.
- (roadmap) [Serve the fixture board per fixture scenario](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3605) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Fixture mode serves a roadmap board per scenario. On the side: on a roadmap item, sub-issue titles wrap, and long status, kind and label chips end in an ellipsis instead of widening the page.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.43.1...v3.44.0
